history.notes: Fixed 432hz not changing the sound on some PCs, for example with Boom3D.

New features
- Theme: put your own picture behind the controls (Settings > Theme). Crop it separately for the window, the column next to the spectrum and the full-screen tab, and darken it so the numbers stay readable.
- With a theme, the middle of the big button is see-through next to the spectrum and in full screen.
- 432hz now tells you when a new version is available.
